t.hi: अपना परिचय छोटे और साफ वाक्यों में दें, जैसे My name is Rani और I am a college student। इंटरव्यू में Tell me about yourself पर I am studying my chosen subject कहें और Why this course पर I enjoy this subject कहें। What are your strengths पर I am regular कहें और What do you want to improve पर I want to speak English better कहें। Why should we select you पर I am ready to learn कहें और What is your goal पर I want to complete my course कहें। How do you handle a problem पर I stay calm कहें और Do you work in a team पर I like working with others कहें। How do you learn something new पर I practise every day कहें और Do you have a question पर Yes, please tell me about the work कहें। रोज बोलें Good morning, Please help me, I understand और Please say that again। यह भी बोलें I am learning, May I come in, Where is the library और Thank you for your time।
t.en: Introduce yourself in short, clear sentences such as My name is Rani and I am a college student. For Tell me about yourself, say I am studying my chosen subject; for Why this course, say I enjoy this subject. For What are your strengths, say I am regular; for What do you want to improve, say I want to speak English better. For Why should we select you, say I am ready to learn; for What is your goal, say I want to complete my course. For How do you handle a problem, say I stay calm; for Do you work in a team, say I like working with others. For How do you learn something new, say I practise every day; for Do you have a question, say Yes, please tell me about the work. Practise saying Good morning, Please help me, I understand and Please say that again. You can also say I am learning, May I come in, Where is the library and Thank you for your time.

q.hi: परिचय देते समय कैसे बोलना अच्छा है?
q.en: How is it best to introduce yourself?

q.hi: What do you want to improve के जवाब में क्या कह सकते हैं?
q.en: What can you say for What do you want to improve?

o.hi: I do not want to learn.
o.en: I do not want to learn.

o.hi: I want to speak English better.
o.en: I want to speak English better.

q.hi: किसी से बात दोहराने के लिए कौन सा वाक्य बोल सकते हैं?
q.en: Which sentence can you use to ask someone to repeat?

a.hi: अपना नाम, पढ़ाई और रुचि छोटे वाक्यों में बताएं। पहले अकेले अभ्यास करें, फिर किसी भरोसेमंद साथी के साथ बोलें।
a.en: Say your name, studies and interests in short sentences. Practise alone first, then speak with someone you trust.

a.hi: जवाब सच और आसान रखें, जैसे I am ready to learn। पहले से दो-तीन बार बोलकर अभ्यास करें।
a.en: Keep answers honest and simple, such as I am ready to learn. Practise saying them a few times beforehand.

a.hi: रोजमर्रा के छोटे वाक्य चुनें और सही मौके पर बोलें। गलती हो तो रुकें नहीं, फिर से कोशिश करें।
a.en: Choose short daily sentences and use them in the right moment. If you make a mistake, keep going and try again.

a.hi: हर दिन थोड़ी देर सुनें और जोर से बोलें। नए वाक्य लिखकर उनका मतलब समझें और दोहराएँ।
a.en: Listen and speak aloud for a little time each day. Write new sentences, understand them and repeat them.
